issues.description: The script intercepts fetch requests and makes a request to https://api.vgen.co/exchange-rate to retrieve exchange rates. This is a first-party API and does not transmit user data or sensitive information.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary data is requested and no user data is sent.

issues.description: The script reads document.cookie to extract the v-guest JWT for currency detection. No cookie data is transmitted externally.
issues.recommendation: Avoid reading cookies unless strictly necessary; do not transmit cookie data.

details: Reads document.cookie to extract v-guest JWT for currency detection

summary: The script does not transmit user data externally, does not collect sensitive information beyond reading a cookie for currency detection, does not execute remote code, and does not use obfuscation. No DOM XSS or supply chain risks are present. Overall, the script is safe with minor privacy collection.
